description: This file defines utility functions related to 'ProviderSpecificHeader' objects, specifically a method to retrieve provider-specific headers based on a given provider name. It includes a class 'ProviderSpecificHeaderUtils' with a static method for extracting headers for a specified custom LLM provider.

classes.name: ProviderSpecificHeaderUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to handle provider-specific headers.

methods.name: Dict get_provider_specific_headers( provider_specific_header: Optional[ProviderSpecificHeader], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Retrieves provider-specific headers for a specified custom LLM provider, handling comma-separated provider lists and returning relevant headers if applicable.
